data.one_liner: Flutter reorderable list and grid with drag-and-drop and insertion/removal animations.
data.what_it_does: Provides AnimatedReorderableListView and AnimatedReorderableGridView widgets supporting drag-and-drop alongside item insert and remove transitions. Also includes standard AnimatedListView and AnimatedGridView widgets without drag-and-drop.
use_when: You need a Flutter list or grid that supports both reordering via drag-and-drop and entry/exit animations.
You want pre-built animations like fade, scale, slide, and flip for list items.
avoid_when: You only need standard static lists or basic Flutter native ReorderableListView without custom animations.
strengths: Supports both ListView and GridView with drag-and-drop and animations simultaneously.
Includes many pre-built enter and exit transitions (fade, scale, flip, slide).
Allows custom animation builders and locked/non-draggable items.
weaknesses: Relies on correct key usage (like ValueKey) for items to properly track animations.
